note: What a server sends to put one effect on several units at once. The header names no object it acts on: the units are listed below.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of effect it is.

fields.name: effect
fields.note: Which effect, by the number its name gives.

fields.name: package
fields.note: Which set of art and sound the client draws it with.

fields.name: runningFor
fields.note: How long it has already run, in seconds.

fields.name: lasts
fields.note: How long it runs in total, in seconds.

fields.name: caster
fields.note: The unit that put it there.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the unit's effect slots it sits in.

fields.name: hidden
fields.note: Whether the client keeps it off the unit's display.
